versions.changelog:
Image Prompt Skill v1.0.0

- Introduced a two-part prompt structure for image generation: (1) detailed variable description of content, and (2) mandatory fixed illustration style.
- Provided explicit requirements and correct examples for consistent and high-quality visual prompts.
- Fixed style includes hand-drawn illustration, landscape format, use of icons/cartoons, visual simplification, and Chinese language preference.
- Listed use cases such as article illustrations, covers, conceptual diagrams, flowcharts, and summaries.
- Established critical reminders: never alter the fixed style section; always use Chinese except for technical terms; and ensure specific scenario details in description.
